models.notes:
LEAN FV-as-prior + earned adjustments (OBP, K-rate, age-vs-level, n_milb_seasons track-record, hit/speed tools; power deliberately omitted = power-correction), shipped as a guarded blend (lam=0.9 toward consensus, WAG-calibrated). BEATS consensus on OOS rank: debuted-KM ridge Spearman 0.341 vs 0.295 (edge +0.046, widened by adding n_milb_seasons +0.010), holds/grows on recent 2019-2023 cohorts (era_split_debuted). 2026-06-22 audit: xFV wins pooled + 4/6 archetypes + every FV tier + every era + every position group; trails consensus only on HS-arms / intl-bats (youngest, lowest-track-record). REJECTED OOS (committed losses): youth*production interaction, decimal age (vs integer baseball-age), signing bonus + draft slot (redundant with consensus FV), level_rank, prod_trend, fv_trend, peak_obp/iso, iso_rel. STRUCTURAL alternatives also tested + REJECTED 2026-06-22 (forward-chained, same folds): two-part P(MLB)xE(WAR|MLB) (marginal full-pool Spearman, costs AUC, ties flagship), monotonic LightGBM + ridge/GBM stack (worse on hitter flagship 0.30/0.32 vs 0.33 -- overfits at n~400/cohort), confidence-weighted shrinkage toward consensus (no change). Conclusion: ridge is at the DATA'S rank ceiling; further gains need NEW data (historical Statcast/Stuff+, which we lack pre-~2023), not more modeling. The misses are irreducible variance (xFV right on 53% of its disagreements w/ consensus). CONDITIONAL POWER also REJECTED 2026-06-22 (the Bobby-Witt power-star miss): realized-in-games power, level-weighted (iso_x_level/iso_upper/peak_iso_x_level) + contact-paired (iso_x_hit/iso_x_contact), all FAILED OOS (best debuted-km -0.0016; replacing tool_speed cost -0.014) -- third independent confirmation (raw iso -> peak iso -> conditional) that game power does not earn a place; the power-star miss is the accepted cost of the population-level power-overpricing correction. THRESHOLD-GATED POWER + CREATIVE COHORT-SLICING also REJECTED 2026-06-22 (per-year-robustness gate added: a pooled pass only counts if positive in >=3/4 forward-chained folds): hit/obp/contact-gated power (iso_gh50/55/60, iso_gobp, iso_gk, pwrtool_gh55, double-gates) = 4th power rejection (best stack +0.0036 pooled but NEGATIVE in 2022+2023 = a 2020-21 artifact); level-weighted production (obp_x_level/k_x_level/obp_upper, add+replace) rejected; 23 creative slices (FV-tier mid-band, age-band x production, up-the-middle x production, breakout prod_trend x level, reliability/exposure weighting, source-disagreement + safe-floor composites) all rejected -- every pooled-passer was a 2020-21 fold artifact that reverses on the freshest cohorts (the level_rank/milb_missing data-vintage fingerprint). The lean hitter set is firmly at its rank ceiling; interactions of already-present linear terms only dilute the regularized ridge. Genuine further lift needs NEW data, not new slicing. Trails on full-pool + MAE (more spread). Live board gated on a pro track record; whole site backgraded (graduates/lingering) onto the live grade scale. Provisional until more cohorts resolve. XFV FEATURE EXPERIMENTS (2026-06-23, owner ask: improve cohorts / pitchers / level-weighting): tested SP/RP role split (pos_prem), AA/A+ per-level production columns, age*level, explicit K-BB%, level-jump, obp*age - forward-chained on the source_backtest per-archetype AUC + xfv_eval Spearman/MAE. RESULT: NULL, none robustly beat the tuned model (committed loss). pos_prem read +0.023 sum AUC (College arms +0.015) but Spearman was FLAT (0.2162->0.2162) + MAE worse -> within the ~+/-0.01 per-cohort AUC NOISE FLOOR (proven: hitter-only feature changes moved pitcher cohort AUCs). level_jump clearly HURT (College bats -0.046). FINDINGS: (1) AA is the single most WAR-predictive level (hitters conditional ridge +0.76, pitchers +0.29) yet explicit AA columns add nothing - the model already captures it (AA = modal final pre-decision level). (2) Int'l bats is the lone cohort consensus still beats (xFV 0.746 vs 0.782 AUC); not fixable from MiLB-stat features (scouts price young low-level projection the stats can't). SHIPPED a DSL LABELING BUGFIX (milb_history: the cached StatsAPI league name is 'DSL' not 'Dominican', so the old substring check folded ALL DSL into CPX and DSL norms were unavailable; now splits DSL/VSL vs CPX + re-derives level on cached reads). Model-NEUTRAL (hitter Spearman +/-0.001; AUC HS arms +0.014 / int'l bats -0.008, net ~flat) - shipped as a CORRECTNESS fix since correct level norms benefit every MiLB-norm surface. HIGH-END TAIL FIX REJECTED (2026-06-25, owner asked 'can a tail fix improve xFV at the high end, ex. Bobby Witt Jr.'): NO - committed as a loss. Forward-chained diagnosis (tools/xfv_tail_lab.py, the SAME OOS protocol as this eval) shows the top tier is already OVER-predicted vs realized first-6yr WAR, not under: FV>=55 hitters predict 10.4 vs realized 7.7 (bias +2.7), pitchers 6.0 vs 3.5 (bias +2.5) - a winner's-curse/attrition artifact that is INVISIBLE in-sample, so no correction fit on train transfers to it. And rank is invariant to any monotone tail transform by construction, so a tail fix cannot move the flagship rank gate either. Tested forward-chained, all LOSSES, none shipped: tail expansion (worsens FV55+ calibration), tail compression (no transfer - collapses to identity), global per-fold linear recalibration (worsens FV55+ MAE/bias - it is MSE-optimal for the bulk, not the bimodal tail), high-FV prior-anchoring lambda dip (rank delta hit -0.001 / pit +0.0002 = noise). The genuine high-end gap is within-elite-tier DISCRIMINATION (FV55+ realized spreads far wider than predictions; within-cohort slope ~2.0) - a new-discriminating-feature problem, NOT a magnitude transform; consistent with xFV at the trainable-data ceiling. Harness kept: tools/xfv_tail_lab.py. PROJECTED-ETA FEATURE REJECTED (2026-06-25, owner asked 'can projected ETA improve xFV'): NO - committed loss. ETA is a transform of level + age, already captured by age_rel_level + the level-relative rate stats. Forward-chained OOS (tools/xfv_lab_runner.py) adding absolute level_rank OR a years-to-MLB eta proxy: hitters rho 0.3699->0.368/0.368 (-0.002), pitchers 0.2787->0.2559 (-0.023, clearly worse); no within-tier gain either. Matches the earlier level-weighting/age*level/AA-column rejections - absolute level adds noise, not signal, on top of the lean set. CLEMENS-FEATURE experiment TESTED + REJECTED 2026-07-06: the Clemens_2026 star-odds and surplus tiers evaluated as eFV features add NO forward signal - they are monotone functions of FV, so their rank vs realized WAR is identical to consensus_fv itself (hitter 0.3735 vs 0.3735; pitcher within noise). The Clemens framework is a market-valuation layer, orthogonal to WAR-outcome ranking; it cannot improve eFV. eFV stays at its trainable-data ceiling. 2026-07-15b owner-ask loss ledgers: defensive tool grades (data/xfv_defense_tools_eval.json - isolated field / D-Tool proxy / position interaction all REGRESS) and physical-by-position (data/xfv_physical_eval.json - BMI arms regress decisively; frame/athl UNTRAINABLE at 0/843 debuted coverage). The WAR target stays offense-dominated; do not re-attempt blind. 2026-07-15c owner directive: the live injury overlay no longer applies the unconditional is_post_tj x0.85 - post-TJ STATUS alone is not an injury (Kade Anderson: fully recovered 2022 TJ, zero IL days, was taxed 15% on WAR/grade/rank/surplus). Active recovery stays priced via il_on/il_days_12mo/il_stints_12mo. 2026-07-15b: 2024-FOLD UNLOCK - DEBUT_YEARS widened to 2011-2024 (+91 debuted censored weight-0.333 rows), terminal-transaction label fix (lifetime DEI ban / retirement resolves censored rows at the observed sum, weight 1.0: marcano/alu/kirilloff), and level_rank added to the lean set via the pre-registered LR-FRINGE gate (t45 +0.0192; docs/efv-2026-07-15/GATES.md). New selftest baseline: blend 0.3765 / wm 0.1652 / t45 0.0795. G-BUGS 2026-07-24 (data/xfv_bughunt_2026_07_24.json): 12 confirmed defects fixed - 2 P0 (eFV surplus now prices through isotonic calibration; P1V3 slot-trust collision gated on acq_year) + feeds label repair (20 MLB-career players were training as 0-WAR busts + 24 mis-resolved ids nulled + resolver vintage guard).

models.metric: held-out truncation error on 988 fully resolved debuts truncated to n_obs 2..5; bias plus bootstrap CI95 by span, side, debut cohort and realized-magnitude bin
models.notes: Audit 2026-08-07b lane B1. VERDICT MATERIAL_BIAS: the projection UNDER-states at every span, monotone, negative on both sides. hit -1.691 CI95[-2.091,-1.267] and pit -0.839 [-1.169,-0.522] at n_obs=2, decaying to null at n_obs=5 (hit -0.062 [-0.168,+0.043]). Mechanism confirmed independently by a second route: seasons 4-6 carry 59.60 percent of six-year WAR mass, so projecting flat from the first two seasons recovers only 64.7 percent of the truth, and that ratio predicts the per-magnitude-bin bias to within about 0.5 WAR. 833 shipped rows ride the projection (hit 382, pit 451). NARROWED BY ADVERSARIAL REVIEW and the narrowing is the honest reading: only n2_hit is material under the lane's own rule (n2_pit clears significance but not materiality), and a single rescale constant collapses the magnitude ladder from (-2.547/-4.516/-7.032) to (-0.856/-0.687/-1.035), so the top-bin figure is the pooled bias expressed at a higher level rather than incremental top-end damage. Multiplicity uncorrected across 48 nested strata. DOWNSTREAM, which is why this artifact matters beyond its own lane: 30.26 percent of rows change realized outcome bucket at n_obs=2, 198 down against 101 up (two to one pessimistic). That is the SAME SIGN as the D3 reliability miscalibration and is the reason lane C1 must not recalibrate against the censored bucket. The star-AUC positive class (WAR>=10) loses 40 percent of its true positives at n_obs=2. NO MODEL CHANGE SHIPPED: a replacement label needs its own gate doc, a rank-identical level twin, a random-label null band and a permutation p-value. Doc docs/efv-2026-08-07b/LABEL_CENSORING_GATE.md. This audit also corrected a long-standing misnomer: the label was called 'KM-censored' across the tree and it is not a Kaplan-Meier estimator, there is no survival fit anywhere on the path.

RE-SWEPT 2026-08-07 on the 11-fold pair-weighted basis, one sweep per side, grid 0.35 to 0.90 across the clamp (data/xfv_driver_lambda_sweep.json, docs/efv-drivers-2026-08-07/GATE_RECORD.md section 8). NEITHER SERVED PIN MOVES. Both curves are monotone decreasing in lambda over the entire grid, so each argmax is the grid edge, which is also the _BLEND_LAMBDA_CLAMP floor: hit 0.70 -> 0.35 is +0.00522 at 0.27x its floor with CI95 [-0.0033, +0.0430]; pit 0.57 -> 0.40 is +0.00286 at 0.27x with CI95 [-0.0042, +0.0216]. Both CIs straddle zero, which is precisely what the reopening rule at efv_model.py:480-483 exists to refuse. The whole hitter band spans 0.0079 in pooled rho and the whole pitcher band 0.0160, so on hitters the entire admissible lambda range is smaller than a single feature-add floor. THE BLOCK-RHO LEG DISAGREES WITH THE POOLED LEG ON HITTERS and is the reason not to read the monotone curve as a finding: hitter block-rho over the grid is flat and non-monotone (0.4014 at 0.35, 0.4002 at 0.70, 0.4011 at 0.60), so 'less model weight is better' is an artifact of between-fold level differences that block-normalization removes; on pitchers the two legs do agree. Churn cost quoted as the reopening rule requires: moving hit 0.70 to 0.35 would re-blend and re-print every hitter grade on the board and halve the model's weight in the headline, for a 0.27x-floor claim that one of the two required instruments does not support, and the 0.85-to-0.70 precedent was itself taken on churn grounds and explicitly NOT as an accuracy claim. Recorded beside the elite-band result (xfv_elite_band): the owner's conviction ask wants MORE model trust at the top and this sweep's own argmax wants LESS model trust everywhere, both sub-floor, and the eval cannot tell the two opposite prescriptions apart. Lambda-shift floors re-derived in the same run: 0.0025 hit / 0.0030 pit for a 0.05 shift and 0.0046 / 0.0055 for a 0.10 shift (data/xfv_driver_floors.json), far tighter than the retired 0.0076-0.011 / 0.005-0.008 and scaling with the size of the shift, which the old single number hid. Lambda is genuinely the one gate class the 11-fold promotion made MORE resolvable.

THE MISMATCH IS REAL AND NOW HAS NUMBERS. p_bucket_given_fv is a proportional-odds fit on five published CONSENSUS-FV cells per side (value_framework_config.yaml:63-77; training_n 678 hit / 437 pit) whose own recorded support is data/value_framework_fitted.json bayes.data_fv_range = [45, 60]. A SECOND mismatch nobody had stated is larger: 65% to 84% of every column sits BELOW the fitted support, the consensus column included, so the table is read outside its range on most rows no matter which scale indexes it. (Two figures in the brief do not reproduce and are corrected in 1.1; the direction and magnitude class are confirmed.) VERDICT: FIXING THE UNITS IS A NULL. The candidate fails the owner's criterion on BOTH required cuts. Pooled it fails with the CI excluding zero in the WRONG direction: vs the flat constant, Brier d = -0.02083 CI95 [-0.03974,-0.00716] P(cand)=0.001 and log loss d = -0.06599 CI95 [-0.11610,-0.03014] P=0.001. On pooled_served the point estimates favour it (+0.03538 / +0.06322) but neither interval excludes zero (CI95 [-0.00727,+0.06996] P=0.932; [-0.04710,+0.15074] P=0.831). THE DECISIVE DIAGNOSTIC settles the attribution: on the pooled frame the table read at its NATIVE consensus-FV index ALSO loses to the flat constant (Brier d = -0.01399 CI95 [-0.02778,+0.00035]; log loss d = -0.04465 CI95 [-0.07921,-0.00875] P=0.006), while on the served-comparable cut the same curve in the same units BEATS it decisively (Brier +0.05656 CI95 [+0.02281,+0.08929] P=1.000; log loss +0.12145 CI95 [+0.04692,+0.19895] P=0.999, both far above their permutation null bands). So the INDEX is exonerated and the POPULATION is convicted: this is a model of a published-list cohort (Clemens 2025, 51-53% bust at FV45) scored on the whole eFV matrix (84-88% bust), and no change of argument crosses a base-rate gap of thirty-five points. That is why re-indexing moves the level the wrong way (calibration-in-the-large -0.1533 to -0.2411) and why the 2026-07-25 recalibration moved only the level. WHAT DOES SURVIVE, registered and NOT recommended: the consensus-scale keying carries genuinely MORE information than the incumbent keying. Pooled AUC 0.8289 vs 0.7967, Murphy resolution 0.0311 vs 0.0273, and the level-shift trap does NOT fire - after out-of-fold Platt recalibration of both arms the candidate still wins, pooled Brier +0.01003 CI95 [+0.00300,+0.02144] P=0.997 and log loss +0.03746 CI95 [+0.01717,+0.07518] P=0.999, both above their null bands (hitter-driven; pitchers are a null). Acting on this would mean stacking the candidate on a recalibration that is itself a measured NULL against a base rate, so it is not assembled here. The variant on pure model WAR instead of the consensus-guarded rank_war (QWAR) is uniformly slightly worse, so the consensus information in rank_war is doing part of the work. Result: blend rho 0.2625 -> 0.2787 (+0.016), within-tier 0.118 -> 0.131, FV-45 fringe 0.107 -> 0.122; hitters UNCHANGED (WAG has signal there, lam stays 0.9). Leakage-free forward-chained selection confirms +0.017; 0.66 is the only move whose player-bootstrap CI stays strictly positive (P>0=0.98) -- the originally-tested 0.85-0.90 oversold (CI crosses zero AND degrades the fringe). XFV FEATURE EXPERIMENTS (2026-06-23, owner ask: improve cohorts / pitchers / level-weighting): tested SP/RP role split (pos_prem), AA/A+ per-level production columns, age*level, explicit K-BB%, level-jump, obp*age - forward-chained on the source_backtest per-archetype AUC + xfv_eval Spearman/MAE. HIGH-END TAIL FIX REJECTED (2026-06-25, owner asked 'can a tail fix improve xFV at the high end, ex. Bobby Witt Jr.'): NO - committed as a loss. Forward-chained diagnosis (tools/xfv_tail_lab.py, the SAME OOS protocol as this eval) shows the top tier is already OVER-predicted vs realized first-6yr WAR, not under: FV>=55 hitters predict 10.4 vs realized 7.7 (bias +2.7), pitchers 6.0 vs 3.5 (bias +2.5) - a winner's-curse/attrition artifact that is INVISIBLE in-sample, so no correction fit on train transfers to it. Tested forward-chained, all LOSSES, none shipped: tail expansion (worsens FV55+ calibration), tail compression (no transfer - collapses to identity), global per-fold linear recalibration (worsens FV55+ MAE/bias - it is MSE-optimal for the bulk, not the bimodal tail), high-FV prior-anchoring lambda dip (rank delta hit -0.001 / pit +0.0002 = noise). CORRECTION TO THE PREMISE, made first: efv_ungraded._grade was NEVER on realized_implied_fv (git log -S returns nothing); the module has always carried its own bespoke linear map, so the platform has THREE maps of predicted WAR, not two. The coherence complaint is nonetheless real and is now sized: prospx.buildEfvRankMap sorts 4,520 graded ACTIVE rows and 3,404 provisional rows together on the single xfv_grade field, and storage._top_end_points / _depth_points rank the farm pool on it, so a ten-FV map gap through the 1.5-3.5 predicted-WAR band is a silent demotion in two served orderings - the exact demotion the 2026-07-25 F2 repair retired when it set _PROV_RANK_PENALTY = 0. THREE OF SIX STOP CONDITIONS FIRE. (1) THE CAP. Under the incumbent affine map an FV constant is also a WAR constant; under outcome_implied_fv the two readings come apart. Pitcher KNEE 34 binds at 2.000 predicted WAR today and at 0.061 after a re-point, CEIL 38 at 2.889 and at 0.176: rows above the knee go 176 to 1,416 of 2,087 pitchers (8.4% to 67.9%), so keeping the FV constants converts a top-end bound into a near-universal compressor and piles 980 arms against a four-FV wall (V0 pitcher max 38.0, p90 37.9, p99 38.0). The WAR-space translation is EXACT (verified numerically, max |dFV| = 0.000000 on a 0.01-WAR grid) and preserves the cap's action identically, but its FV outputs breach the module's words: hitter max 49.5 above the CEIL 49 asymptote, and a cameo capped at 'org filler' would print 40.9 hit / 42.9 pit instead of 30. Neither branch is a no-op, so 'leave the cap alone' was the destructive option, not the conservative one. (2) THE DOCUMENTED CALIBRATION. The module's spec is 'MOST land 20-30', 'a true 45+ would have been graded', 'hitters median ~23 / 77% <= 30; pitchers median ~24 / 87% <= 30'. Pooled share <= 30 falls 0.923 to 0.641 (V0) / 0.491 (V1); rows >= 35 go 71 to 1,185 / 1,696; rows >= 45 go 1 to 32 / 62. Under V1 the median un-scouted org PITCHER is a 40.5 FV and 1,114 of 2,087 are 40 or better, up from zero. MECHANISM: 48.5% of the pool (1,650 of 3,404) has non-positive predicted WAR and outcome_implied_fv returns exactly 20.0 for all of it, so the re-point deletes the org-filler ladder the bespoke map exists to provide and leaves two spikes. models.predicts: realized first-6-MLB-season bWAR -> a provisional, capped FV grade for prospects with MiLB production but NO source FV grade (DSL/CPX breakouts + org filler)
models.champion: xfv_ungraded_v0 (no-FV production ridge)
models.baseline: none for the cohort (these players have no consensus FV at all); the bar is positive OOS rank vs realized WAR
models.metric: forward-chained OOS Spearman vs realized first-6yr bWAR on the low-minors target cohort
models.notes: A DEDICATED no-FV production ridge (NOT the flagship; the flagship is FV-anchored and ABSTAINS on ungraded players). Imputing a constant FV into the shipped model FAILS (FV weight dominant -> production-only predictions floor at the -2 WAR clamp) -> a re-fit no-FV model is the fix. Forward-chained (data/xfv_ungraded_eval.json): HITTERS keep level_rank, low-minors DSL/CPX/A age<=21 Spearman ~0.22 / all-levels ~0.31 (~matches the 0.26 consensus FV gets on graded low-minors bats, for players with NO grade); PITCHERS DROP level_rank (it HURTS the low-minors read), low-minors 0.09 -> 0.24. GRADE MAP = conventional linear war->FV with an ORDER-PRESERVING SOFT CAP (compress above a knee toward a ceiling), NOT a hard cap. CAP TEST (2026-06-23, owner asked 'is 43 too low / do we need a hard cap'): for HITTERS the uncapped grade carries REAL forward-chained signal above 43 (realized 6yr WAR bins [43,48) mean 3.43, [48+) mean 6.10; Spearman 0.29 among >=40) so a hard cap at 43 DISCARDED signal -> soft knee 43 / ceil 49 lets genuine young-for-level breakouts grade mid-to-high-40s; for PITCHERS signal above 40 is NOISE (Spearman 0.077, flat bins; top uncapped = small-sample high-K complex-ball spikes) so knee 38 / ceil 42 compresses hard. Soft so order is preserved (matters now that grades fold into the rank). Distribution: hit median ~23 / 77% <=30 / max ~49; pit median ~24.5 / 87% <=30 / max 42. Reliability shrinkage keeps small DSL lines from spiking. Franklin Primera (CPX, 19) = #1 ungraded hitter breakout at ~45. models.surface: /mlbstats/ Hitter Leaderboards, xHEM+ + Luck columns (Savant deserved offense)
models.predicts: a hitter's DESERVED offensive rate: the HEM+ ratio scale applied to Savant expected wOBA (xwOBA) instead of actual wOBA; xwOBA strips BABIP/sequencing luck, so it is the more forward-stable talent signal. Luck = xHEM+ minus HEM+
models.champion: xhem_plus (100 * xwOBA / PA-weighted pool xwOBA; tracked hitters, min 100 Savant PA)
models.baseline: actual wOBA forward rho vs wOBA(Y+1)
models.metric: forward-chained Spearman: xwOBA(Y) vs wOBA(Y+1) beats actual wOBA(Y) (seeded bootstrap CI on the gap)
models.notes: SHIPPED 2026-07-05 (X-H3) as a deserved-offense companion to HEM+. Forward-chained OOS over 8 year-pairs 2016-2025 (ex-2020, 1871 pairs): Savant xwOBA predicts next-year wOBA at rho 0.4543 vs actual wOBA 0.4108; the bootstrap gap CI clears zero (lo95 +0.0173), so xwOBA is decisively the more forward-stable talent signal and xHEM+ earns its place. It is a COMPANION, not a replacement: Savant is MLB-only + min-BBE gated, so xHEM+ stamps only tracked hitters with a real sample (min 100 Savant PA -- a 1-PA player who homered is not 'deserving' a 244). No further shrink (xwOBA is already de-luck'd). Luck = xHEM+ - HEM+: positive = under-performing his contact (room to bounce back), negative = over-performing (due to regress). Joined in hitter_export._join_xhem_plus from mlb_player_export._savant. Harness tools/xhem_plus_lab.py.

HONEST FRAMING (loss ledger): Statcast xwOBA-allowed was tested against FIP for the pitcher models and did NOT win, so REM+ stays FIP-based; xREM+ is a companion contact-quality-inclusive deserved read plus a Luck residual, never a claim of sharper prediction. Inverts the hitter xHEM+ ratio (lower allowed xwOBA = higher +, mirroring rem_plus = 100*poolFIP/playerFIP) and anchors over the RELIEVER board so 100 = the average reliever. Luck = actual wOBA-allowed minus expected (positive = allowed more than his contact deserved = unlucky, room to improve). MLB-only + min-BBE gated (min 80 batters faced); missing -> column blank. Joined in bullpen_export._join_xrem_plus from mlb_player_export._savant('expected'). No independent predictive eval by design (would re-open the rejected beat-FIP comparison); an X-H3-style deserved-vs-actual forward gate is a clean follow-up.
